summary: Candidate is a distinct safety_rule for Virtual WAN branch connection routing consistency (Point-to-site, Site-to-site, ExpressRoute associations to Default route table). It does not semantically overlap with existing skills: the peer candidates address different routing concerns (spoke VNet firewall consistency, multiple next hop validation, hub router IP validation), and the existing skill is from an unrelated domain (Maven repository security). The candidate represents a new, well-scoped routing policy enforcement capability with clear constraints and validation steps.
